title: Review Team Intake Standard for the Limit-Review Claim Amount (Cartwise Grocery Orders)
content:
## Review Team Intake Standard — limit-review claim amount

**Standard.** On Cartwise Grocery Orders, the limit-review claim value is the claimed line's billed charge. The limit-review claim amount is the limit-review claim value, rounded to the cent.

**The claimed line** is the item line the customer's limit-review claim names. Its billed charge is the total of the amounts on its billed item line charge entries on the order, in dollars.

**Rounding.** The claim amount is rounded to the cent, half up. A billed charge is already held in cents, so for a charge read directly from the line entries the rounding leaves the figure as it is.

### Intake examples (hypothetical figures)

| Claimed line as billed | Billed charge | Limit-review claim amount |
|---|---|---|
| 2 units of a perishable item at 6.49 | 12.98 | 12.98 |
| 1 unit at 23.10 | 23.10 | 23.10 |
| 4 units at 3.25 | 13.00 | 13.00 |

**Figure worked through.** A hypothetical claim names line 3 of a No-Rush Delivery order, billed for 2 units at 6.49. The billed charge is 2 times 6.49, that is 12.98; the claim amount is 12.98 rounded to the cent, that is 12.98, and that is the amount the claim asks the review team for.
